//: Colours are lifted from src/index.css (the shipped petrol accent, light theme) and from the icon (public/icon.svg: the hero teal, the gold of its coin), so the marketing set cannot drift from the app.
//font: The app's own bundled typeface, loaded from the app's file (assets/fonts/fonts.css points at src/assets/fonts/): `display` sets the headline and the ribbon at `displayWeight`, `text` the subline and the points.
//backgrounds: Presets referenced by slide.background: one flat colour and what stands on it. fill = the canvas; ink = the headline; inkSoft = the subline; shade = the colour every shadow is mixed from (a darker tone of the fill, never grey); chip / chipInk / tick = a point's pill, its text and its tick; ribbon / ribbonInk = the corner ribbon. petrol is the icon's own colour and the app's accent (--acc-l) with white type and the coin's gold for the ribbon; mist is the same hue as a light canvas with petrol ink, the quieter alternative; night is the app's dark page as a canvas, for a screen shown in dark mode (`night: true` — validate.py does not count it as a second colour). One preset for the whole set; night only for a dark screen.
//device: The frame is drawn in CSS, not composited from a PNG (assets/frames/README.md); its proportions are in templates/slide.css. bezel is its colour: near black with a little of the petrol in it, so it sits on the canvas instead of cutting a hole in it.
